trap.label: verbo + -ing
trap.wrong: I enjoy to work here and she finished to plan.
trap.right: I enjoy working here, and she finished planning.
trap.why: Em português “gosto de trabalhar” e “terminou de planejar” usam infinitivo. Em inglês, enjoy, finish, avoid e keep pedem -ing.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com avoid: “He doesn't take breaks.”
Reescreva com keep: “We try again and again.”
